title: Field Cursor-on-Target (CoT)
description: Data payload for msg_type 'cot'. Carries a parsed Cursor-on-Target (CoT) event as used in tactical field networks (TAK/ATAK/WinTAK), including position, error estimates, and raw detail XML.

uid.description: Globally unique identifier for this CoT event/entity (e.g. 'ANDROID-abc123').

type.description: CoT type string (e.g. 'a-f-G-U-C' for friendly ground unit, 'a-h-A-M-F-Q' for hostile fixed-wing). Follows the CoT type taxonomy.

how.description: CoT 'how' attribute indicating how the position was determined (e.g. 'm-g' for GPS, 'h-e' for human entered).

callsign.description: Human-readable callsign or display name for this entity.

hae.description: Height above the WGS-84 ellipsoid in metres.

ce.description: Circular error (horizontal position error estimate) in metres at 90% confidence.

le.description: Linear error (vertical position error estimate) in metres at 90% confidence.

stale_at.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds after which this CoT event should be considered stale.

detail_raw.description: Raw XML string of the CoT <detail> element. Null if no detail element was present.
